Pass.description: The step is sound and complete enough: no point you could raise would definitely lead the thinker to materially better next steps. Use verdict "Pass", a substantive one-or-two-sentence reason (at least 30 characters — never placeholder text), an empty suggestion, and the fixed evidence object with kind "none" and every detail field empty.

Build.description: The step is sound, but an important COMPLEMENTARY point would definitely improve the next steps. Use verdict "Build", a substantive reason (at least 30 characters), the concrete non-empty suggestion (at least 20 characters), and the fixed evidence object with kind "none" and every detail field empty.

Interrupt.description: There is a real FLAW such that a wrong chain would be built on this step. Interrupt requires evidence: runnable script, self-contained math derivation, or real reference. Use verdict "Interrupt", the specific substantive reason (at least 30 characters), and the evidence object; leave the suggestion empty unless you have a concrete repair to hand the thinker. Without evidence choose Build or Pass.
